label: open-rotation-submenu
js: (() => { const e=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-menu-item]')].find((c)=>c.offsetParent && c.getAttribute('data-menu-item')==='标签旋转'); if(!e) return 'no-item'; const r=e.getBoundingClientRect(); return JSON.stringify({x:r.left+r.width/2,y:r.top+r.height/2}) })()

label: show-start-page
js: (() => { const e=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-menu-item]')].find((c)=>c.offsetParent && c.getAttribute('data-menu-item')==='显示启始页(M)'); e?.click(); return true })()

label: seed-recent-file
js: (async () => { const saved = await window.maxlabel.saveTemplateToLib('A9-recent-sample', JSON.stringify({version:1,name:'A9-recent-sample',widthMm:60,heightMm:40,objects:[]})); if(!saved?.ok) return 'save-failed'; localStorage.setItem('maxlabel.recent', JSON.stringify([{title:'A9-recent-sample',path:saved.path,state:0}])); location.reload(); return true })()
